title: Vibrant Light American Eggs Frittata
description: A grassy, light, and energizing American dish featuring eggs, tempering chocolate, and pescatarian-friendly ingredients, perfect for a morning boost.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Whisk the eggs in a large bowl and set aside.
Chop the green onions and smoked salmon, then add them to the bowl with the eggs.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the egg mixture and stir gently.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler and drizzle it over the egg mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch pie plate.
Bake the frittata in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.
Remove the frittata from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
